highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m156 and expands supported platform tooling.
highlights_body: This release restores Linux system-font discovery without bundled dependencies, refreshes desktop rendering samples, and aligns native assets with upcoming .NET releases.

bullets.detail: Aligns the bundled renderer with Skia m156 and incorporates the m155 core fork cleanup.
Linux applications using the NoDependencies package can again discover system fonts.

bullets.lead: Desktop and WebAssembly platform support refreshed
bullets.detail: Adds native GTK4 GPU rendering and pixel scaling, aligns WebAssembly assets with .NET 11 previews, and updates Tizen builds to GCC 14.2.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored Linux system-font discovery for NoDependencies package consumers
